title: Transport failure! Relay allocation needs to be recreated, and NetworkManager restarted. Use NetworkManager.OnTransportF
notes: Fix 2026-10-15 by claude (24ba982c81): No code change. One Relay disconnect at 16:52:00, logged by Unity's transport/Netcode packages: 'player timed out due to inactivity' (the host sent nothing for ~10 s - an editor hitch, breakpoint or pause), then transport failure and host shutdown. Not game code; closes if it does not recur.
